identity_cost.detail: email: the sign-in form labels its account field 'Email' ('<label for="loginId" class="text-[13px] font-medium text-black/50 tracking-tight leading-tight">Email</label>'), and the terms require an account with a username, a password and contact information ('You may be required to sign up for an account, select a password and username ("Airtop User ID"), and provide us with certain information or data, such as your contact information.'). A card is not published: https://www.airtop.ai/pricing lists a $0 Free plan and states no card requirement, and registration is closed ('we’re no longer accepting new signups'), so the sign-up form was not read.
